source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: After looking up discovered folders and awaiting an Inbox update, test_listClosesDB asserts that five selected folders have no cached database. cachedDBForFolder resolves the summary-file path and calls FindInCache. This is a direct cache-membership assertion for those folders, not proof that every production owner releases every database. Discovery setup still uses a fixed delay, and the test was not run in this study.
title: The IMAP discovery test checks selected database cache entries
